changesets_one_active_revert.name: changesets_one_active_revert
changesets_one_active_revert.where: "changesets"."revert_of" is not null and "changesets"."status" not in ('FAILED', 'STALE', 'BLOCKED')

rules_scope_consistent.name: rules_scope_consistent
rules_scope_consistent.value:
("rules"."scope_kind" = 'org' and "rules"."account_id" is null and "rules"."campaign_entity_id" is null)
        or ("rules"."scope_kind" = 'account' and "rules"."account_id" is not null and "rules"."campaign_entity_id" is null)
        or ("rules"."scope_kind" = 'campaign' and "rules"."account_id" is not null and "rules"."campaign_entity_id" is not null)
